_readme: Edit this file to control the benchmark. true/false = on/off. CLI args override these values when provided.
_workers: How many IPs to test at the same time. Example: 1 = safe/slow, 4 = faster but more CPU/RAM. Start with 1 on Windows.
_max_ips: Limit how many IPs from cfip.txt are tested. 0 = test all. Example: 10 tests only the first 10 IPs.
_report_name: Optional prefix for Excel/log filenames. Example: "iran_test" -> results/[iran_test] cf_ip_benchmark_....xlsx
_clear_temp: After run: true = delete temp configs, false = keep them, null = ask you at the end.

display._comment: What is shown on screen / written to log while running.
display._show_progress: Print lines like '... measuring latency...' so the app does not look frozen. Example: false = quieter output.
display._show_live_result: Print a full result block after each IP test. Example: false = only final tables.
display._show_final_tables: Print ranking tables at the end.
display._colored_output: Reserved for colorized terminal (colorama). Keep true.
display._write_log_file: Write a live log under logs/. Example: false = no log file.

baseline._comment: Measures YOUR real internet WITHOUT any proxy, then compares proxy results against it.
baseline._enabled: Example: false skips the direct-connection speed test at startup.

tests._comment: Core speed tests run through each CF IP + config.

latency._enabled: Ping-style RTT via Cloudflare trace. Example: false skips latency (scores that need latency will be weaker).
latency._samples: How many latency samples per IP. Example: 3 = faster run, 10 = more accurate.

download._enabled: Download test from speed.cloudflare.com. Example: false = no download Mbps.
download._bytes: Payload size in bytes. Example: 100000 = faster/lighter, 1000000 = heavier stress test.
download._rounds: How many download rounds to average. Example: 1 = quick, 3 = more stable.

upload._enabled: Upload test to speed.cloudflare.com. Example: false = skip upload (Instagram score may drop).
upload._bytes: Upload payload size in bytes. Example: 50000 for slower lines.
upload._rounds: Upload rounds to average. Example: 2 for more accuracy.

relay._comment: Real-world open times to major sites (through the proxy). Disable sites you do not care about.
relay._enabled: Master switch for all relay tests. false = skip every site below.
relay._samples_per_site: Requests per site. Example: 1 = faster, 3 = more stable average.

Google._comment: Example: set enabled=false to skip Google relay.

scoring._comment: Scores are always 0-10. Disable a category to ignore it in Overall and hide its Top table.
scoring._web: Web-browsing score (latency + download focused). Example: false hides Web score.
scoring._gaming: Gaming score (low latency + low jitter + low loss).

overall_weights._comment: Weights for Overall. Do not need to sum to 1; they are normalized. Disabled categories get weight 0.

ranking._comment: How the final tables are built.
ranking._top_n: How many IPs to list in each Top table. Example: 10 shows Top 10.
ranking._sort_by: Default sort key for overall ranking. Options: overall | web_score | insta_score | gaming_score | lat_avg | dl_avg
ranking._compare_with_baseline: Show 'vs Direct' delta column. Example: false hides comparison with your real line.

timeouts._http_seconds: HTTP timeout per request through the proxy. Example: 8 on fast lines, 20 on slow ones.
timeouts._xray_startup_seconds: Max wait for local SOCKS port after starting xray. Example: 5.0 if antivirus is slow.

paths._comment: Relative to the script folder. Change only if you rename files/folders.
paths._cfip_file: List of CF IPs / CIDRs / domains. Formats: plain IP, CIDR, domain, or 'dl - ul - IP'.
paths._links_file: One share-link per line (vless:// vmess:// trojan://).

excel._enabled: Write results to results/*.xlsx. Example: false = no Excel file.

filter._comment: Skip bad IPs early so the run stays fast.
filter._enabled: If true, do a quick connect check before full tests.
filter._max_latency_ms: If first ping is above this (ms), skip the IP. Example: 1500 stricter, 3000 more tolerant.
filter._quick_timeout_seconds: Short timeout for the first connectivity probe. Example: 2 on fast lines, 5 on slow.
filter._require_exit_ip: If true, IP is skipped when exit IP cannot be read.
